value.title: Frozen Blade
value.synopsis: Clarence steps up to defend Katrina from her family's attacks.

value.title: The Noble Wall
value.synopsis: Clarence takes Katrina to meet the royal family.

value.title: The Warmth That Melted the Loneliness
value.synopsis: Clarence and Katrina express their feelings for each other to the king.

value.title: To the Me Who’s Worthy of Being by Your Side
value.synopsis: After Clarence declares his love to Katrina in the garden, she puts herself through rigorous training, worried about their difference in social standing.

value.title: A Light That Won't Fade, Even When Struck
value.synopsis: Katarina is abducted by her stepmother and Charlotte after Clarence steps out for patrol.

value.title: The Life I Swore to Protect
value.synopsis: Clarence rushes to rescue Katrina while she tries to escape the Sashebal estate.

value.title: To You, a Love That Never Melts
value.synopsis: Clarence uses his ice magic to save Katarina and free her from her old household.
